whyWrong.Parce que: Parce que means 'because' (the answer) — the question word is Pourquoi.

items.fullSentence: — Pourquoi tu vas au cinéma ? — Parce que j'aime les films.
items.sentenceTrans: — Why do you go to the cinema? — Because I like films.

whyWrong.Pourquoi: Pourquoi asks 'why' — the answer starts with Parce que.

whyWrong.amusante: amusante is feminine — with c'est use the masculine amusant.
whyWrong.amusants: amusants is plural — c'est takes the singular amusant.
whyWrong.amuser: amuser is the verb 'to amuse' — you need the adjective amusant.

whyWrong.calmes: calmes is plural — c'est takes the singular calme.
whyWrong.le calme: le calme is the noun 'calm' — you need the adjective calme.
whyWrong.calmer: calmer is the verb 'to calm' — you need the adjective calme.
